Linear Regression.info: Predicts a continuous target by fitting a linear equation to observed data, assuming a straight-line relationship between features and the outcome.

ElasticNet.info: Combines L1 and L2 regularization, making it effective when there are multiple correlated features.

Random Forest.info: Ensemble of decision trees that improves predictive accuracy by averaging multiple results.

XGBoost.info: Optimized distributed gradient boosting library designed to be highly efficient and flexible.

LightGBM.info: Fast, distributed gradient boosting framework that uses tree-based learning algorithms with leaf-wise growth.

CatBoost.info: Gradient boosting on decision trees with native support for categorical features.

LSTM.info: Long Short-Term Memory network is a recurrent neural network architecture capable of learning long-term temporal dependencies in sequential data.

TCN.info: Temporal Convolutional Network uses causal and dilated convolutions to model long-range temporal dependencies efficiently.

DeepAR.info: Autoregressive recurrent network that produces probabilistic multi-step forecasts by learning a global model across related time series.

TFT.info: Temporal Fusion Transformer combines LSTM encoders, gating layers, and interpretable multi-head attention to model static, known, and observed inputs for multi-horizon forecasting.

hidden_size.warning: hidden_size must be exactly divisible by num_attention_heads.

PatchTST.info: Splits each time series into patches processed independently per channel by a Transformer encoder, improving long-horizon forecasting accuracy and efficiency.

patch_len.warning: patch_len must be less than the lookback window.

d_model.warning: d_model must be exactly divisible by n_heads.

TimesNet.info: Transforms 1D time series into 2D tensors based on discovered periodicities and applies Inception-style convolution blocks to capture intra- and inter-period variations.

DLinear.info: Decomposes the series into trend and seasonal components, each modeled by a single linear layer, offering a strong lightweight baseline for long-term forecasting.

Transformer.info: Transformer architecture relies on self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies and relationships within sequential data.

d_model.warning: d_model must be exactly divisible by nhead.

Informer.info: Informer is an efficient Transformer variant specifically designed for long-sequence time-series forecasting using ProbSparse attention.

d_model.warning: d_model must be exactly divisible by n_heads.

Autoformer.info: Combines series decomposition with an auto-correlation mechanism in place of self-attention to efficiently capture period-based dependencies for long-term forecasting.

d_model.warning: d_model must be exactly divisible by n_heads.

FEDformer.info: Frequency Enhanced Decomposed Transformer improves long-term forecasting by combining decomposition methods with frequency-domain attention.

d_model.warning: d_model must be exactly divisible by n_heads.

GRU.info: Gated Recurrent Unit network, a recurrent architecture similar to LSTM but with fewer gates, offering efficient modeling of sequential dependencies at reduced computational cost.

N-BEATS.info: Neural Basis Expansion Analysis for Time Series stacks fully connected layers with backward and forward residual links to model trend and seasonality without domain-specific components.

N-HiTS.info: Neural Hierarchical Interpolation for Time Series decomposes the forecast across hierarchical stacks with multi-rate sampling, improving long-horizon accuracy and efficiency.

TiDE.info: Time-series Dense Encoder-decoder architecture that uses stacked residual MLP blocks with dense encoding of covariates for efficient long-horizon forecasting.

TSMixer.info: All-MLP architecture that alternates time-mixing and feature-mixing layers to capture temporal and cross-variate dependencies without attention or recurrence.
